title: The Owner picks how the crew talks (Straight, House or Theatrical), and personality shows only in headlines, empty states and check-ins
description: Master plan v2 (2026-11-11): opening FlowWeb should feel like checking in on a crew that has it handled and is mildly theatrical about it. Dry and confident, never a cartoon mascot: no emoji confetti, no exclamation-mark cheer. Each Owner sets a personality dial: straight, house (the default) or theatrical. Personality lives only in three slots: headlines, empty states and check-ins. A pure catalog LINES[slot][voice] holds at least 5 lines per slot and voice, with no em dash, exclamation mark or emoji, and Straight shares no line with Theatrical. pick(slot, voice, week, used) is stable and never repeats a line within a week while an unused one is left, so the voice does not get old. Numbers, warnings, money and anything that sends stay plain: plain(kind, value) takes no voice. Only the Owner hears the crew; customers always get the brand voice, so drafts never read the dial. GET and POST /v1/voice read and set the dial, and it survives a restart. Per-CEO heat (Juniper hotter than Kevin) comes with the roster. Wave 2 of the master plan v2.
acceptance: LINES has at least 5 clean lines for headline, empty_state and check_in in each of straight, house and theatrical; Straight and Theatrical share none
pick is stable and five picks in one week never repeat; plain formats $1.50 and 1,234 and takes no voice
A fresh fwd answers house; POST /v1/voice sets theatrical (unknown voice 400, no session 401) and it survives a restart
